inspectorLines: Hmm. Valid until 08:59:59. It is now 08:59:58.
So you are technically on time. 'Technically' — the saddest word in any language.
Look around. Everyone on this platform has your face. Did you notice?
Go on. Your inbox has been waiting for you since 3 a.m.
Have a productive day. That is not a wish. It is a requirement.

mirror: One more day. You've got this. Probably.
You're allowed to be more than your job title.
plant: At least someone here is growing.
The plant forgives me. For now.
cat: Purr. The only one who needs nothing from me.
The cat approves of my burnout.
Five more minutes? The cat agrees.

intro.beggarPrompt: E — listen to the old tanuki
beggarLines: I am freer than you are.
No boss. No inbox. No deadline. Just the blossoms.
You run every morning. I sit. Who is winning?
Spare a minute? Not yen — a minute. You don't have one, do you?
My calendar is completely empty. Envy me.
The petals fall whether you are on time or not.
I used to have a corner office. Now I have the whole corner.
Freedom is just a boundary you kept.
The blossoms don't hurry. They still arrive on time.

mochiLines: You ate lunch away from your desk.
You looked out of the window. The world is still there.
Snack break. The inbox didn't even notice.
You breathed out. Fully. First time today.
Sugar is not a strategy. But a break is.
You stood up and stretched. Your spine says thanks.
coffeeLines: Break taken. The emails survived without you.
Five minutes off. Nothing caught fire.
Coffee with a colleague. Turns out they're nice.
You didn't check your phone. Growth.
Pause is a feature, not a bug.
helpLines: You're not alone on this floor.
A shared problem is half a problem.
Kindness: the only KPI that compounds.

lift.title: The Lift

lines.text: The CEO is… handled. So are the printer, the client and the coffee machine.
I saw. The whole floor saw. HR is already drafting a memo about the noise.
…Can I tell you something? Off the record.
Is anything ever off the record in this building?
I haven't seen my kids awake since March. I answer emails in the shower.
Health Week gave me a stress ball. I squeezed it until it popped. Then I emailed facilities about the stress ball.
…That's the most honest thing anyone has said here all year.
I used to think tired meant important. It doesn't. It just means tired.
So here is the plan. Tomorrow you take your full lunch break. Away from the desk. Somewhere with sky.
At 17:00 you go home. The laptop stays. Notifications off. The emails will still be here. That's the problem with emails.
It's the only order I've ever meant.
Me? …I'll take the stairs. Slowly. Maybe I'll look at a tree. People say they're nice.
Ground floor. Go home, bunny. That's how we win.

burnoutLines: I'm moving to a farm. The goats don't send emails.

burnoutSincere: Burnout isn't a personal failure. Rest. Talk to someone. Try again.
You're not lazy. You're empty. Refill first, then retry.
In real life: tell someone you trust how you're really doing.
Rest is part of the work, not a reward for finishing it.
Nobody wins by running on empty. Not even the CEO.
end.winClosing: 17:00. You went home on time. Nothing caught fire.
end._positivityNote: burnoutSincere: one sincere line under the joke. winClosing: shown on the win screen. Self-care = breaks + mochi + helpful colleagues (points in config.json → scoring.selfCarePoints).

tips: Good. This is what a break looks like.
Look 20 metres away for 20 seconds. Your eyes will thank you.
Unclench your jaw. Drop your shoulders. Breathe.
Drink some water. The game will wait.
Stand up and stretch. We'll keep your place.
Real life tip: it's okay to say no to one more thing.
